# 3. Functions

```{python}
def get_header_value(lines: list[str], pattern: str) -> str | None:
    out = [re.sub(pattern, "", ln.replace("\t", "")) for ln in lines if re.search(pattern, ln)]
    return out[0] if len(out) > 0 else None


def extract_bio(year_qtr: str) -> None:
    con = connect_sqlite(year_qtr)

    try:
        compsubm_table = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM compsubm", con)

        rows = []
        for _, r in compsubm_table.iterrows():
            lines = str(r["COMLSUBFILE"]).split("\n")
            rows.append(
                {
                    "FILENAME": r["FILENAME"],
                    "form": get_header_value(lines, r"CONFORMED SUBMISSION TYPE:"),
                    "cik": get_header_value(lines, r"CENTRAL INDEX KEY:"),
                    "cikname": get_header_value(lines, r"COMPANY CONFORMED NAME:"),
                    "rdate": pd.to_datetime(get_header_value(lines, r"CONFORMED PERIOD OF REPORT:"), errors="coerce"),
                    "fdate": pd.to_datetime(get_header_value(lines, r"FILED AS OF DATE:"), errors="coerce"),
                }
            )

        header_table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
        header_table.to_sql("header_table", con, if_exists="replace", index=False)
    finally:
        disconnect_sqlite(con)
```

```{python}
def clean_block(
    x: list[str],
    use_cusip_join: bool,
    cusip_vec: list[str],
    cusip_vec_8: list[str],
    cusip_vec_7: list[str],
    error_rows: list[str],
) -> list[str]:
    x = [ln for ln in x if len(ln.strip()) > 0]

    if use_cusip_join and len(cusip_vec) > 0:
        has_cusip = []
        for ln in x:
            xx = re.sub(r"\s|-", "", ln)
            n = len(xx)
            ok = False

            if n >= 9:
                for s in range(0, n - 8):
                    if xx[s : s + 9] in cusip_vec:
                        ok = True
                        break

            if (not ok) and n >= 8:
                for s in range(0, n - 7):
                    if xx[s : s + 8] in cusip_vec_8:
                        ok = True
                        break

            if (not ok) and n >= 7:
                for s in range(0, n - 6):
                    if xx[s : s + 7] in cusip_vec_7:
                        ok = True
                        break

            has_cusip.append(ok)
    else:
        has_cusip = [bool(re.search(r"[0-9A-Z]{7,8}[0-9]?", re.sub(r"\s|-", "", ln), re.I)) for ln in x]

    x = [ln for ln, keep in zip(x, has_cusip) if keep]

    err_pat = re.compile("|".join(re.escape(e) for e in error_rows), re.I) if len(error_rows) else None
    if err_pat is not None:
        x = [ln for ln in x if not err_pat.search(ln)]

    out = []
    for ln in x:
        num_chunks = re.findall(r"\d[\d,\.]*", ln)
        if len(num_chunks) >= 3:
            out.append(ln)

    return out


def make_holdings(
    lines: list[str],
    use_cusip_join: bool,
    cusip_vec: list[str],
    cusip_vec_8: list[str],
    cusip_vec_7: list[str],
    error_rows: list[str],
) -> list[str]:
    if all(len(ln.strip()) == 0 for ln in lines):
        return []

    info_start = [bool(re.search(r"<[^/]*informationTable", ln, re.I)) for ln in lines]
    info_end = [bool(re.search(r"</[^>]*informationTable", ln, re.I)) for ln in lines]
    if any(info_start) and any(info_end):
        start = info_start.index(True)
        end = len(lines) - 1 - info_end[::-1].index(True)
        return lines[start : end + 1]

    hold = []

    table_start = [i for i, ln in enumerate(lines) if re.search(r"<TABLE>", ln, re.I)]
    table_end = [i for i, ln in enumerate(lines) if re.search(r"</TABLE>", ln, re.I)]

    if len(table_start) > 0 and len(table_end) > 0:
        block_tbl = lines[table_start[0] : table_end[-1] + 1]
        hold_tbl = clean_block(block_tbl, use_cusip_join, cusip_vec, cusip_vec_8, cusip_vec_7, error_rows)
        if len(hold_tbl) > 0:
            hold = hold_tbl

    if len(hold) == 0:
        idx_hdr = [i for i, ln in enumerate(lines) if re.search(r"</SEC-HEADER>", ln, re.I)]
        start_fb = (max(idx_hdr) + 1) if len(idx_hdr) else 0
        block_fb = lines[start_fb:]
        hold = clean_block(block_fb, use_cusip_join, cusip_vec, cusip_vec_8, cusip_vec_7, error_rows)

    return hold


def extract_holdings(year_qtr: str) -> None:
    con = connect_sqlite(year_qtr)

    try:
        yr = int(str(year_qtr)[:4])
        use_cusip_join = yr >= 1996

        cusip_vec = get_cusip_vec(con, year_qtr) if use_cusip_join else []
        cusip_vec_8 = [x[:8] for x in cusip_vec] if len(cusip_vec) > 0 else []
        cusip_vec_7 = [x[:7] for x in cusip_vec] if len(cusip_vec) > 0 else []

        compsubm_table = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM compsubm", con)
        compsubm_table["lines"] = compsubm_table["COMLSUBFILE"].fillna("").astype(str).str.split("\n")

        error_rows = [
            "<SEC-DOCUMENT>", "<SEC-HEADER>", "ACCESSION NUMBER:",
            "<ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME>", "<FILENAME>", "<phone>", "Phone:",
            "</additionalInformation>", "FORM 13F", "INFORMATION TABLE",
            "SUMMARY PAGE", "RUN DATE", "PAGE",
            "List of Other Managers", "SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION",
            "ITEM ", "ITEM1", "ITEM 1:", "COL ", "COL1", "COLUMN", "Suite", "<DESCRIPTION>",
        ]

        use_parallel = int(year_qtr) < 20132
        print("  Mode:", "parallel" if use_parallel else "sequential")

        def run_one(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
            return make_holdings(
                lines,
                use_cusip_join=use_cusip_join,
                cusip_vec=cusip_vec,
                cusip_vec_8=cusip_vec_8,
                cusip_vec_7=cusip_vec_7,
                error_rows=error_rows,
            )

        if use_parallel:
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=min(cfg.workers, 5)) as ex:
                holding_lines = list(ex.map(run_one, compsubm_table["lines"].tolist()))
        else:
            holding_lines = [run_one(x) for x in compsubm_table["lines"].tolist()]

        holdings_table_raw = pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "FILENAME": compsubm_table["FILENAME"],
                "holding_text": ["\n".join(x) for x in holding_lines],
            }
        )

        holdings_table_raw.to_sql("holdings_table_raw", con, if_exists="replace", index=False)
    finally:
        disconnect_sqlite(con)
```

# 4. Loop all functions

```{python}
for i, yq in enumerate(dates["year_qtr"].tolist(), start=1):
    print(f"\n=== Quarter {i}/{len(dates)}: {yq} ===")

    start_time = time.time()

    print(f"Running extract_bio for {yq}...")
    extract_bio(yq)
    print(f"Finished extract_bio for {yq}")

    print(f"Running extract_holdings for {yq}...")
    extract_holdings(yq)
    print(f"Finished extract_holdings for {yq}")

    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    print(f"Total time for {yq}: {elapsed / 60:.1f} minutes ({elapsed:.1f} seconds)")
```

# 5. Extract summary

```{python}
def summarise_extract_quarter(year_qtr: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    con = connect_sqlite(year_qtr)

    try:
        has_table = con.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='holdings_table_raw'"
        ).fetchone()

        if has_table is None:
            return pd.DataFrame(
                {
                    "year_qtr": [year_qtr],
                    "n_filings": [pd.NA],
                    "n_empty": [pd.NA],
                }
            )

        out = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT holding_text FROM holdings_table_raw", con)
        return pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "year_qtr": [year_qtr],
                "n_filings": [len(out)],
                "n_empty": [(out["holding_text"] == "").sum()],
            }
        )
    finally:
        disconnect_sqlite(con)


extract_summary = pd.concat([summarise_extract_quarter(yq) for yq in dates["year_qtr"].tolist()], ignore_index=True)
extract_summary["pct_empty"] = extract_summary["n_empty"] / extract_summary["n_filings"]
extract_summary.to_csv(qa_dir_02 / "extract_summary.csv", index=False)
```

```{python}
plot_df = extract_summary.dropna(subset=["n_filings"]).copy()
plot_df["year"] = plot_df["year_qtr"].str[:4].astype(int)
plot_df["qtr"] = plot_df["year_qtr"].str[4].astype(int)
plot_df["date"] = pd.PeriodIndex(plot_df["year"].astype(str) + "Q" + plot_df["qtr"].astype(str), freq="Q").to_timestamp()
plot_df["pct_empty"] = plot_df["pct_empty"] * 100

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
plt.plot(plot_df["date"], plot_df["pct_empty"], label="Empty filings (%)", color="steelblue")
plt.scatter(plot_df["date"], plot_df["pct_empty"], s=8, color="steelblue")
plt.plot(plot_df["date"], plot_df["n_filings"] / 100, label="Total filings (/100)", color="darkorange")
plt.title("Extraction quality vs. number of 13F filings over time")
plt.xlabel("Quarter")
plt.legend(loc="lower center", ncol=2)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(qa_dir_02 / "extract_summary.png", dpi=300)
plt.close()
```
